elements.title: Englewood Methodist Church (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that crews assembled the structure of Englewood Methodist Church (pictured) in just four days by using Thomas Moore's design for precast concrete panels?

elements.title: Otonose Kanade (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Otonose Kanade sang one song 100 times during a 6-hour 48-minute livestream?

elements.title: Submarine (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: Lázaro Peña (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Lázaro Peña was arrested multiple times for his labor activism, including in 1953 for alleged "subversive activity"?

elements.title: Old Skies (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the video game Old Skies was praised for its handling of a time traveler revisiting events surrounding the September 11 attacks?

elements.title: Tiberiu Iliescu (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a 1982 anthology referred to Romanian writer Tiberiu Iliescu as still "honing [his] craft" – four years after his death aged 71?

elements.title: Neptune Theatre Restaurant (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Neptune Theatre Restaurant had its own in-house dance troupe?

elements.title: Jean-Jacques Moll (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Jean-Jacques Moll made plans for cities of 100,000 inhabitants that could be built anywhere on a relatively flat site?

elements.title: parrot pie (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a cookbook from Victorian Britain contained recipes for parrot pie and roast wallaby?
